name: ai.privos.mcp-app-demo
title: PrivOS Demo MCP App
description: Reference PrivOS MCP app demonstrating HR workflows, scoped workspace APIs, AI and sandbox controls, and license-aware features.

permissions.reason: Identify the approved installation and room so the dashboard can load safely.
Add the installation-owned agent bot to the exact Room approved by the Hub.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The app cannot add its installation-owned agent bot to this Room.

permissions.reason: Read safe identity for the installation bot only when it belongs to the exact approved Room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The app cannot display the installation bot identity for this Room.

permissions.reason: Read the HR lists selected for this room.
Page and search HR records without reading the whole list.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The records table falls back to the unpaged list route, which returns at most 500 items and says so instead of showing a silent subset.

permissions.reason: Create and update HR records from the dashboard.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The dashboard remains read-only.

permissions.reason: Send a bell, native mobile, and Web Push notification to one active member of the exact approved room from the Notification demo tab.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Notification tab cannot send notifications.

permissions.reason: List and preview HR documents attached to the room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Document previews and the room file list are hidden.

permissions.reason: Upload HR documents and generated exports to the room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Uploads remain disabled; existing records are unchanged.

permissions.reason: Show and select the skills enabled in the room sandbox.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Sandbox skill controls are hidden.

permissions.reason: Upload an agent set into the workspace factory on behalf of a workspace administrator.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The app cannot upload agent sets; existing sets can still be selected for the room.

permissions.reason: Connect the room sandbox to its installation-specific bot identity.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The dashboard cannot connect or rotate the sandbox bot identity.

permissions.reason: Wake the approved room sandbox and display its state.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Sandbox wake and state controls are unavailable.

permissions.reason: Start and poll a Sandbox generation as the current user, optionally selecting the installation-owned agent bot as executor, to demonstrate the room's Sandbox workload lifecycle.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Bot workload tab cannot start or poll a Sandbox attempt.

permissions.reason: Read AI chat history created in the approved room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Existing AI chat sessions are not displayed.

permissions.reason: Start, send, and stop AI chat work in the approved room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: AI chat remains read-only when read access is granted, or hidden otherwise.

permissions.reason: Read this app's own room-scoped App Database records and App Objects (CAS) metadata/content in the App Objects and App Database demo tabs, exercised through this app's own installation-bot credential.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The App Objects and App Database demo tabs cannot read anything back.

permissions.reason: Store an immutable content-addressed App Object and create records in this app's own room-scoped App Database collection, in the App Objects and App Database demo tabs.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The App Objects and App Database demo tabs cannot store or create anything.

permissions.reason: Read the demo App Database collection's registered schema in the App Database demo tab.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The App Database demo tab cannot display its collection schema.

permissions.reason: Register the demo App Database collection's schema (mcpapp.db.registerCollection) once per room, in the App Database demo tab.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The App Database demo tab cannot register its demo collection.

permissions.reason: Read the approved room's custom-permission catalog and which members hold each permission, in the Custom permissions demo tab.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Custom permissions tab cannot display the room's permission catalog or membership.

permissions.reason: Grant a custom permission's holders read or read+edit access to one isolated-list item (additionalReaders/additionalEditors), and mint/assign a demo permission, from the Custom permissions demo tab. The Hub still requires the acting user to be room owner/admin.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Custom permissions tab cannot grant item-level access, nor mint/assign a demo permission.

permissions.reason: Resolve a typed member username to its user id so the Custom permissions demo tab can assign a permission by username instead of a raw user id.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Custom permissions tab cannot assign a permission by username; mint and item grant still work.

dataPolicy.retention: App data is retained until the installation or corresponding HR records are deleted.

tools.name: hr_management_dashboard
tools.title: PrivOS Demo MCP App
tools.description: Open the interactive HR workflow and PrivOS platform demonstration dashboard.

tools.name: hr_whoami
tools.title: Who am I (verified)
tools.description: Return the user identity authenticated by the Hub's body-bound private dispatch assertion.

tools.name: hr_bulk_export
tools.title: Bulk export HR records
tools.description: Export records in bulk. Requires the Pro tier.

tools.name: hr_agent_bot_credential_check
tools.title: Validate agent bot credential
tools.description: Confirm this app's configured agent bot credential authenticates against the Hub.

tools.name: hr_app_object_store
tools.title: App Objects (CAS) demo
tools.description: Store/read one immutable, room-private, content-addressed object via mcpapp.objects.put/head/get, authenticated with this app's own installation-bot credential. Live only once this room's Hub is on tenant.132+.

roomId.description: Optional; must equal the room this call is made from (defaults to it).

tools.name: hr_app_db_store
tools.title: App Database demo
tools.description: Register a demo collection, create/query records, and read its schema via mcpapp.db.registerCollection / create / query / getSchema, authenticated with this app's own installation-bot credential. Live only once this room's Hub is on tenant.132+.

roomId.description: Optional; must equal the room this call is made from (defaults to it).

env.description: Company name shown in the HR dashboard header.

Password for the SMTP account payslip mail is sent through.
This app's agent bot Hub API credential. Issued and rotated only by a workspace admin from this app's settings page, never by this app.
